script_text: Stop, Pisces — Neptune, your ruling planet of the Water element, is manipulating the currents beneath the surface of your life. Saturn is clashing with Mars in your 2nd House of Finances, creating intense pressure around money and self-worth that demands your complete attention. Meanwhile, the Sun glides through your 7th House of Partnerships in Virgo, putting your closest relationship under a powerful cosmic microscope. Someone from your past could resurface through this Water sign energy, and if you're committed, a difficult conversation about shared finances could shift everything. With Saturn squaring Mars in your 2nd House, avoid impulsive purchases — build long-term security, never quick fixes. Don't sign any contracts before Wednesday when Mercury shifts signs. Neptune reminds you that intuition outranks all logic for Pisces today. Subscribe so you don't miss what Jupiter brings to your 5th House next week.
